description: This file contains the implementation of fuel calculation logic for an engine control system, including functions for calculating fuel injection durations, fuel map initialization, and various correction factors based on sensor inputs. It defines behaviors specific to engine fuel management, such as injection timing, correction curves, and fuel map lookup routines.

methods.name: getRealMafFuel
methods.description: Calculates the total duration of fuel injection per engine cycle based on MAF sensor data, RPM, and engine load.

methods.name: getBaseFuel
methods.description: Returns the base fuel amount, adjusted for TPS acceleration and different fuel algorithms such as speed density or MAF.

methods.name: getInjectionOffset
methods.description: Calculates the injection phase offset based on engine RPM and load.

methods.name: getNumberOfInjections
methods.description: Determines the number of injections per engine cycle depending on the injection mode.

methods.name: getInjectorDutyCycle
methods.description: Calculates the duty cycle percentage of the injector based on injection duration and engine cycle duration.

methods.name: getInjectionDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration of fuel injection in milliseconds, considering engine mode, injection mode, and injection count.

methods.name: getRunningFuel
methods.description: Applies correction factors to the base fuel amount considering temperature and other corrections.

methods.name: getInjectorLag
methods.description: Calculates the injector open time delay correction based on battery voltage.

methods.name: initFuelMap
methods.description: Initializes the fuel map data structure for interpolation.

methods.name: getCltFuelCorrection
methods.description: Retrieves the correction factor based on coolant temperature.

methods.name: getCltTimingCorrection
methods.description: Provides timing correction based on coolant temperature.

methods.name: getIatFuelCorrection
methods.description: Retrieves correction based on Intake Air Temperature (IAT).

methods.name: getFuelCutOffCorrection
methods.description: Returns a tapering correction factor for fuel cut-off during coasting or other conditions.

methods.name: getBaseTableFuel
methods.description: Lookup in the fuel map to get the injection duration based on RPM and engine load.

methods.name: getBaroCorrection
methods.description: Provides correction based on barometric pressure, if a sensor is present.

methods.name: getCrankingFuel
methods.description: Calculates the fuel duration during engine cranking based on coolant temp and start timing.

methods.name: getCrankingFuel3
methods.description: Detailed calculation of cranking fuel duration based on coolant temperature, revolution count, TPS, and configured curves.

methods.name: getFuelRate
methods.description: Computes fuel flow rate based on injection duration and engine cycle time.
